title: File:45th Space Wing Supports Successful Falcon 9 L-24 Starlink Launch (210428-F-KD758-241).jpg
art: U.S. Space Force photo by Joshua Conti
desc: A Falcon 9 Starlink L-24 rocket successfully launches from SLC-40 at Cape Canaveral Space Force Station, Fla., April 28, 2021. This is the ninth Starlink launch of 2021, which sent the 25th batch of Starlink satellites to join the Starlink satellite network. (U.S. Space Force photo by Joshua Conti)
